verdict.rationale: Meltano is open source and self-hosted, so you "own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers." The project is a version-controllable software project with plugins defined in a project file, and transformations use standard dbt. That means configuration and pipeline logic stay portable and leaving is structurally easy. However, the evidence never documents an explicit export path or open data formats, and says nothing about leaving the managed hosted offering. missing for 10: explicit documentation of data/config export in open formats, an exit path from the Meltano-hosted service, independent hands-on corroboration of migrating away.
